description: This file defines the PdfPages class, which manages a collection of PdfPage objects within a PDF document. It provides functionality for adding, inserting, removing, and enumerating pages, as well as handling page tree flattening and importing external pages. The class interacts with other PDF-related classes and manages the internal page array and page count.

classes.name: PdfPages.PdfPagesEnumerator
classes.description: Enumerator for iterating over PdfPage objects in PdfPages collection.

classes.name: PdfPages.Keys
classes.description: Contains key definitions for the PdfPages dictionary, inheriting from PdfPage.InheritablePageKeys.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Gets the number of pages in the document, depending on modification mode.

methods.name: this[int index]
methods.description: Accesses a PdfPage by its index within the pages collection.

methods.name: FindPage
methods.description: Finds a page by its object ID.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Creates and adds a new empty PdfPage to the end of the collection.

methods.name: Add(PdfPage page)
methods.description: Adds an existing PdfPage object to the end of the collection.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Creates and inserts a new PdfPage at a specified position.

methods.name: Insert(int index, PdfPage page)
methods.description: Inserts a specific PdfPage at a specified index, importing from external if necessary.

methods.name: InsertRange
methods.description: Inserts a range of pages from a document into the collection.

methods.name: InsertRange(int index, PdfDocument document, int startIndex, int pageCount)
methods.description: Copies a range of pages from another document into this collection.

methods.name: InsertRange(int index, PdfDocument document)
methods.description: Inserts all pages from another document.

methods.name: InsertRange(int index, PdfDocument document, int startIndex)
methods.description: Inserts pages starting from startIndex from another document.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a specific PdfPage from the collection.

methods.name: RemoveAt
methods.description: Removes a page at a specified index.

methods.name: MovePage
methods.description: Moves a page within the collection from one index to another (not supported in PDF/UA mode).

methods.name: ImportExternalPage
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an external PdfPage for import into this document.

methods.name: CloneElement
methods.description: Helper method to clone or import elements from an external page.

methods.name: RemapReference
methods.description: Remaps references of imported pages to new references.

methods.name: FlattenPageTree
methods.description: Replaces the page tree with a flat array of page references.

methods.name: GetKids
methods.description: Recursively collects pages from a page tree into a flat array.

methods.name: PrepareForSave
methods.description: Prepares all pages in the collection for document saving.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator to iterate over pages.
